scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --filter ops-console build && pnpm --filter mock-consumer build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter ops-console typecheck && pnpm --filter mock-consumer typecheck && pnpm --filter admin-ui typecheck && pnpm --filter quiz-player typecheck
scripts.test: vitest run --exclude '**/tests/{e2e,browser}/**' && pnpm --filter ops-console test && pnpm --filter mock-consumer test && pnpm --filter admin-ui test
